# Clip 1.3.11
Clip 1.3.11 makes the recording and Live Share controls more fluid while keeping native viewer windows stable as they change size and state.
## Popovers and viewer windows
- Keep the menu-bar popover and Live Share controls stable while expanding, replacing, or returning from compact states. - Improve native viewer window transitions and controls across resizing, reopening, and recording-state changes. - Preserve viewer presentation state and source-resolution behavior as the native viewer changes layout.
## Requirements
Clip requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon. This build uses the same stable Apple Development identity as previous updater releases.
